speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is The presence of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on the left dorsal hand. I also have No tenderness, No pain.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. The description of a rough, sandpaper-like plaque on the sun-exposed dorsal hand of a 65-year-old with a history of sunbathing is classic for this actinic damage. Given her age and risk factors, this requires monitoring to prevent progression to squamous cell carcinoma.
